topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I came home to find a stack of papers on the kitchen table, the kind with lines that smell faintly of ink. Curiosity nudged me closer. As I flipped through, I realized it was a story, and the characters were unmistakably us. There I was, written with a depth I didn't know I had. The quiet moments, the laughter, the soft undercurrents of our life together, all spun into words. It was a surprise, a revelation even, but there was a warmth to it, like finding a hidden garden in the heart of the city. I set the papers down, feeling the weight of them, and a smile crept across my face.
